edits.title: Carry the point into the request
edits.incitement: The first action should make clear that arrival is possible while the point remains in the hand. Leave the later paragraphs to develop repetition.
edits.old: The red arrow says “drag point here”. Carry the point towards it. Watch for the falling balls. Leave and return by another route.
edits.new: The red arrow says “drag point here”. Carry the point towards it without letting go. Watch for the falling balls.
edits.purpose: Invite an arrival while holding the point, before explaining what makes the target respond.
edits.reader_move: Carry the point towards the arrow and watch for the consequence.
edits.why_here: The point has been located and reported; it can now be brought into a request.
edits.without: The reader may assume that release or exact placement is required.

edits.title: Give the comparison room
edits.incitement: Explain the two operations the reader needs to read the test, then return their numerical meaning to the hand.
edits.old: The comparison accepts a position within 0.45 metres of a centre 1.20 metres above the target's origin. A hand has room to arrive. The accepted position can be close enough without being identical to the centre.
edits.new: `distance_to()` measures the gap between the point and the target's centre. `<=` asks whether that distance is 0.45 metres or less. The centre sits 1.20 metres above the target's origin. A hand has room to arrive. “Here” has become a small region.
edits.purpose: Explain distance and the inclusive comparison while showing how a named location becomes a region that admits several positions.
edits.reader_move: Connect the two code operations to room for the carried point to arrive.
edits.why_here: The reader has just seen the reduced acceptance function and needs to understand what it admits.
edits.without: The numbers describe dimensions without fully opening the operation that uses them.

edits.title: Describe the small memory through its consequence
edits.incitement: Group-registration and rearming terminology interrupts the scene. The visitor can investigate the same behavior by staying, leaving and returning.
edits.old: The target checks points registered in its coordinate-point group. It requires no release and rearms when the point leaves. A careful delivery and an accidental pass can bring the same rain. Your intention never enters this comparison.
edits.new: The target remembers whether the point is already inside. Staying there produces no further fall; leaving and returning allows another. A careful delivery and an accidental pass can bring the same rain. Your intention never enters this comparison.
edits.purpose: Make the entry memory understandable through repeated movement while keeping the distinction between proximity and intention.
edits.reader_move: Stay within the region, then leave and return.
edits.why_here: Distance explains acceptance; the small memory explains why a continuous stay is not a continuous shower.
edits.without: Repeated triggering remains a control term rather than a behavior the reader can understand.

edits.title: Give the detour a rhythm
edits.incitement: The destination-as-instrument image already works. A direct return and a longer route give the reader a concrete way to play it.
edits.old: Return again, and a destination can become an instrument. The rhythm of your arrivals changes what the room's instruction is useful for. A detour may matter to that rhythm while remaining absent from the success test. We could give the target a memory of the journey; we would then have to decide what it remembers, and what someone else could read from it.
edits.new: Return again, and a destination can become an instrument. Come straight back once; next time, take a longer way round. The target accepts both arrivals, but you have changed the pause between them. A detour may matter to what you are making while remaining absent from the distance test. We could give the target a memory of the journey; we would then have to decide what it remembers, and what someone else could read from it.
edits.purpose: Turn repeated arrival into a possible rhythmic practice and keep recording the journey as a further, consequential design choice.
edits.reader_move: Vary the route and the pause between returns.
edits.why_here: The rule is now understood well enough to be used for another purpose, preparing the question of a journey that the next halls develop.
edits.without: The image of an instrument has less bodily instruction to make it available.
